## Change Category 1: Code Enforcement (✅ COMPLETE)

No ripple changes required - enforcement already complete.

Components Verified:
  ✅ repos/metabob-cli/src/metabob_cli/mcp/tools.py
     - metabob_activity_save (lines 5595-5682)
     - metabob_activity_load (lines 5684-5771)
  
  ✅ repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/tool/impulse-create.ts
     - Backend sync via metabob_impulse_store (lines 71-110)
  
  ✅ repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/session/activity.ts
     - Activity.save backend sync (lines 664-710)
     - Activity.load backend fallback (lines 488-565)

Blast Radius: NONE - No additional components need updates

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Change Category 2: Data Flow Consistency (✅ VERIFIED)

All data flows updated consistently:

Impulse Creation Flow:
  Before: impulse_create → Storage.write (local only)
  After:  impulse_create → Storage.write (cache) + metabob_impulse_store
  Status: ✅ CONSISTENT

Activity Persistence Flow:
  Before: Activity.save() → Storage.write (local only)
  After:  Activity.save() → Storage.write (cache) + metabob_activity_save
  Status: ✅ CONSISTENT

Activity Retrieval Flow:
  Before: Activity.load() → Storage.read (local only)
  After:  Activity.load() → Storage.read OR metabob_activity_load (fallback)
  Status: ✅ CONSISTENT

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Change Category 3: Entry Points (✅ VERIFIED)

All entry points properly route through vessel flow:

✅ impulse-create tool
   - Calls metabob_impulse_store via MCP.clients()
   - Respects (api_key, project_id) scoping
   - Graceful degradation when MCP unavailable

✅ Activity.save method
   - Calls metabob_activity_save via MCP.clients()
   - Tool existence check
   - Non-blocking for local workflows

✅ Activity.load method
   - Falls back to metabob_activity_load
   - Try-catch for error handling
   - Local storage is fast path

Ripple Required: NONE - All entry points already updated

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Change Category 4: Transformations (✅ VERIFIED)

Data transformations maintain consistency:

✅ Storage Key Construction
   - Uses (api_key, project_id) scoping
   - Consistent across CLI and OpenCode
   - Verified in validation tests

✅ Activity Data Format
   - Activity.Info serialization consistent
   - Compatible with backend expectations
   - Schema validation handled by backend

✅ Impulse Data Format
   - Impulse serialization consistent
   - Compatible with /v2/impulses endpoint
   - No transformation needed

Ripple Required: NONE - Transformations already consistent

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Change Category 5: Validations (✅ VERIFIED)

Validation logic is consistent:

✅ Input Validation
   - api_key presence checked
   - project_id presence checked
   - activity_id format validated

✅ Tool Existence Validation
   - MCP.clients() checks tool availability
   - Graceful handling when tool missing
   - Logged warnings for debugging

✅ Backend Response Validation
   - HTTP status codes checked
   - Error responses handled
   - Retry logic not implemented (deferred)

Ripple Required: NONE - Validations already comprehensive

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Change Category 6: Exit Points (✅ VERIFIED)

All exit points properly handle responses:

✅ metabob_impulse_store (CLI tool)
   - Returns JSON status
   - Logs success/failure
   - Forwards errors from backend

✅ metabob_activity_save (CLI tool)
   - Returns JSON status
   - Includes created_at timestamp
   - Forwards errors from backend

✅ metabob_activity_load (CLI tool)
   - Returns activity_data on success
   - Returns not_found on 404
   - Forwards errors from backend

Ripple Required: NONE - Exit points already consistent
